effects: Takes `amount` of SIS (collateral 0xd38B…6dd9) from the signer through safeTransferFrom to the vault; the signer must have approved the vault first.
Mints active vault shares (computed from current stake and shares) to `onBehalfOf`, who owns the new staked position; this can be someone other than the signer.
formats.shown: Deposit 123.25 SIS into the vault, with the shares credited to the named beneficiary address.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares minted to the beneficiary is not shown; it comes from vault storage.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol deposit: `mintedShares = ERC4626Math.previewDeposit(depositedAmount, activeShares_, activeStake_);` uses storage values. The descriptor shows only `#.amount` and `#.onBehalfOf`.
findings.fix: None possible: the share count is not in the calldata.

effects: Burns enough of the signer's active vault shares to cover `amount` SIS, rounded up; no tokens move in this call.

Queues `amount` SIS for withdrawal in the next epoch and credits the withdrawal shares to `claimer`. Only `claimer` can claim them later, so a claimer other than the signer receives the right to these funds.
The queued amount can still be slashed until it is claimed.
formats.shown: Request a withdrawal of 2.5 SIS from the vault, with the claim owned by the named claimer address.

findings.title: withdraw: the shares burned from the signer and the slashing exposure of the queued amount are not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol withdraw: `burnedShares = ERC4626Math.previewWithdraw(amount, activeShares(), activeStake());` and _withdraw adds the amount to `withdrawals[epoch]`, which onSlash can reduce. The screen shows only 'Requested assets' and 'Claim owner'.
findings.fix: None needed from calldata. A note that the funds can be claimed after the epoch ends and stay slashable until then would help.

effects: Burns `shares` of the signer's active vault shares.
Queues the SIS value of those shares (from storage) for withdrawal in the next epoch and credits the claim to `claimer`. A claimer other than the signer receives the right to these funds.
formats.shown: Queue 987654321123456789 raw vault shares for withdrawal, with the claim owned by the named claimer address.

findings.title: redeem: the share amount is shown as a raw 18-decimal integer that people cannot read.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem field `#.shares` uses format 'raw', so case 2 shows 'Queue 987654321123456789 raw shares'. ERC4626Math `_decimalsOffset()` returns 0, so shares have the same decimals as the collateral (SIS, 18).
findings.fix: Use format 'unit' with params {decimals: 18, base: 'shares'} so the screen shows '0.987654321 shares' and does not suggest SIS.

findings.title: redeem: the amount of SIS queued for the shares is not shown; it comes from vault storage.

effects: Marks the signer's withdrawal for `epoch` as claimed.
Sends all of the signer's matured SIS withdrawal for that epoch (amount from storage) to `recipient`, who may be someone other than the signer.
formats.shown: Claim the withdrawal for epoch 42 to the named recipient address.

findings.title: claim: the intent and fields never name SIS as the asset sent to the recipient.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claim: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount);`, with collateral fixed to 0xd38BB4…6dd9 (SIS) at init. The descriptor intent reads 'Claim withdrawal' and the interpolated intent 'Claim epoch {epoch} to {recipient}'.
findings.fix: Use the interpolated intent 'Claim SIS withdrawal for epoch {epoch} to {recipient}'.

findings.title: claim: the SIS amount sent is read from storage and cannot be shown.

effects: Marks the signer's withdrawal for each listed epoch as claimed.
Sends the sum of the signer's matured SIS withdrawals for all listed epochs (amounts from storage) to `recipient`, who may be someone other than the signer.
formats.shown: Claim the withdrawals for epochs 42, 44 and 128 to the named recipient address.

findings.title: claimBatch: the intent and fields never name SIS as the asset sent to the recipient.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount);`. The descriptor intent reads 'Claim withdrawals' and the interpolated intent 'Claim epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}'.
findings.fix: Use the interpolated intent 'Claim SIS withdrawals for epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}'.

findings.title: claimBatch: the total SIS amount sent is read from storage and cannot be shown.
